message_templates_occasion_shape.name: message_templates_occasion_shape
message_templates_occasion_shape.value: ("message_templates"."timing_type" = 'occasion') = ("message_templates"."segment" = 'D') and ("message_templates"."timing_type" <> 'occasion' or ("message_templates"."timing_value" = 0 and "message_templates"."statuses" is not null))

message_templates_attempts_values.name: message_templates_attempts_values
message_templates_attempts_values.value: "message_templates"."attempts" is null or (cardinality("message_templates"."attempts") > 0 and "message_templates"."attempts" <@ array[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]::smallint[] and "message_templates"."segment" in ('A', 'B'))

sent_messages_undeleted_idx.name: sent_messages_undeleted_idx
sent_messages_undeleted_idx.where: "sent_messages"."sent_at" is not null and "sent_messages"."deleted_at" is null and "sent_messages"."delete_error" is null

videos_marks_order.name: videos_marks_order
videos_marks_order.value:
"videos"."duration" > 0
        AND ("videos"."intro_end_sec" IS NULL OR ("videos"."intro_end_sec" >= 0 AND "videos"."intro_end_sec" < COALESCE("videos"."course_start_sec", "videos"."price_sec", "videos"."duration")))
        AND ("videos"."course_start_sec" IS NULL OR "videos"."course_start_sec" > 0)
        AND ("videos"."course_start_sec" IS NULL OR "videos"."price_sec" IS NULL OR "videos"."course_start_sec" < "videos"."price_sec")
        AND ("videos"."price_sec" IS NULL OR "videos"."price_sec" < "videos"."duration")
        AND ("videos"."unlock_sec" IS NULL OR ("videos"."unlock_sec" > 0 AND "videos"."unlock_sec" < "videos"."duration"))
